terminal.emulator: fresh direct PTY with deterministic loopback HTTP/SSE

reference.capture: Hades local setup followed by bounded model selection, one streamed request, and fresh-process readback

normalization: Binary paths, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, PTY paths, timestamps, process identifiers, raw redraw bytes, and ephemeral server ports are omitted or represented by stable markers.

The loopback server records only normalized request path, content type, model, stream flag, message roles, prompt markers, request count, and authorization presence; no credential value or external request is used.
The selection status is recorded as a stable visible marker, while sidecar bytes are compared privately for equality and no Hermes config.yaml is created.
The fresh-process step intentionally proves non-persistence; session selection is not promoted into saved provider configuration.

steps.precondition: hades setup --local has written only a Hades sidecar with vertical-model; a fresh 120x40 process reaches the ready composer.

input_sequence.value: Enter twice to open the model picker
Enter to open model stage, Enter to select palette-model

output.cleanup: exit 0; alternate screen left; canonical input and echo restored

steps.precondition: The selected process has exited; a fresh process reuses the unchanged Hades sidecar without any selection input.

output.cleanup: exit 0; alternate screen left; canonical input and echo restored

unknowns: Hermes selection persistence and effective use for a distinct model remain bounded by OBS-0093; this Hades extension deliberately chooses a safer explicit session-scoped contract.
Provider catalogs beyond the deterministic palette row, multiple selected models, unavailable models, external providers, OAuth, tools, and concurrent selection/request races remain separate work.
Hermes repeated metadata requests and failure behavior are not copied into Hades without independent evidence.
